results.label: ACTUAL parent restart isolates inherited lazy M102 default strategy-v1 initialization
the M108 parent141 really is the previous milestone: it has gate/intention/practice modules and no ask module or route at all
the parent produced owned records to inherit: 3 trades, one completed practice receipt and a recorded intention
M109 adds NO schema object of any kind: every table, index and trigger on the upgraded tree is byte-identical to the parent’s
every inherited fact is byte-identical after the upgrade: trades, gate answers, intention and the practice receipt
the inherited practice receipt still reads as the parent recorded it, and the channel did not create the lazy timer row on upgrade
the delivered tree serves the channel on the inherited database, and every surface answers from the records the parent wrote
the inherited intention and the inherited practice receipt are quoted back as records, with the parent’s own note and template
the refusals and the honest non-answer behave identically on an inherited database
the same question answers the same bytes on the upgraded tree as well
asking on the inherited database writes nothing: not one table changed, not even sqlite_sequence
the inherited trade counts and practice receipt are still exactly as the parent left them after the whole battery
the first live entry after the channel was used answers exactly as the parent tree answered before it
a trader who has never recorded anything is answered with honest unrecorded lines, never invented content
even on a fresh workspace the channel created no practice timer row, so its read-only claim does not depend on existing rows

scope: Actual141-file M108 parent own records → delivered tree on the same database: zero schema objects added, every inherited fact byte-identical, no writes on any ask; synthetic/local, not broker/real-money proof
